_: CA-GROUPS (DESIGN §5.10 "Groups"): the groups v1 creates, as data - converted by internal/tools/ConvertFrom-EpsV1Groups.ps1 from v1's locked config (target groups), Entra-ConditionalAccess-Management.ps1 (the break-glass group, the administrative units) and each CAnnn.ps1 (the per-policy exclude and pilot groups, the dynamic pilot rule per stage). A customer's imported eps.TargetGroup / eps.AdminUnit wins over these.
